faults.page says: The footer lists the museum as "㈜아모레퍼시픽 미술관" with a placeholder business number (123-45-67890) above the separate Amorepacific Corp company block. No page states the legal form of the museum or that a company runs it; the form is read from the name prefix.
No cited text states that Amorepacific Corp owns or runs the museum.

faults.stored: The museum site footer lists the museum under the Amorepacific Corp company details and names Amorepacific Corp as host.
faults.page says: The footer line is "호스팅제공자 : (주)아모레퍼시픽", which names the web hosting provider of the site, not the host of the museum.

The About page calls ARKO "a national organization for the arts and culture established in 1973"; the History page says it began as a foundation in 1973 and was restructured in 2005 as a consensus-based decision-making body of practising artists. Neither page states ARKO's legal form today, a government-appointed board, or a statute that makes it a public body.

faults.stored: The ARKO history page says the council descends from a foundation set up in 1973 under the Culture and Arts Promotion Act and was refounded when the Act was revised in 2005; its organisation chart lists ARKO Art Center as one of its units.
faults.page says: The organisation chart is on the About page, not the History page, and no cited page states the form of the body.
